title: Why Are Mining Truck Tires Taller Than a Person?
description:
Stand next to the wheel of a Caterpillar seven nine seven and you will not reach the top of the tire. You will not even reach the middle. Each tire is about four meters tall and weighs around five tonnes, as much as two family cars. The truck carries more than three hundred and sixty tonnes of rock in one trip. Today, eleven parts of a giant mining truck, and why each one exists.

Machine Reverse takes apart the machines you see every day and explains, part by part, why each one exists. This video covers 11 parts.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:09 1. The tire taller than a person
2:41 2. The tire filled with nitrogen
4:05 3. The tire's speed limit
5:22 4. The staircase on the front
6:31 5. The roof over the cab
7:44 6. The electric motors in the wheels
9:10 7. The giant radiator
10:24 8. The sensors on the mast
11:39 9. The eight tires of the BelAZ
12:57 10. The car that disappears
14:16 11. The heated dump body
15:25 The verdict

Sources:
- Caterpillar 797F (363 t payload, C175-20 engine ~106 L, ~4,000 hp, 59/80R63 tires, top speed ~68 km/h): Caterpillar 797F spec sheet https://www.cat.com/en_US/products/new/equipment/off-highway-trucks/mining-trucks/18093383.html and Wikipedia, "Caterpillar 797" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caterpillar_797
- Giant tire size, construction and the 2005-2008 OTR tire shortage: Wikipedia, "Haul truck" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haul_truck ; Michelin Earthmover tire data book https://business.michelin.com/
- Tire pyrolysis explosions, nitrogen inflation, exclusion zones: MSHA, "Tire and Rim Safety" https://www.msha.gov/ ; NSW Resources Regulator / Queensland mine safety alerts on tyre explosions https://www.resourcesregulator.nsw.gov.au/
- TKPH (tonne-kilometre per hour) tire heat rating: Michelin / Bridgestone OTR technical data books
- Stairs, three points of contact, access systems: MSHA, "Mobile Equipment Safety" https://www.msha.gov/
- Canopy, ROPS, dump body liners: Komatsu 930E product brochure https://www.komatsu.com/ and Wikipedia, "Haul truck"
- Diesel-electric drive, wheel motors, dynamic retarding: Wikipedia, "Komatsu 930E" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komatsu_930E ; Unit Rig Lectra Haul history https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_Rig
- Trolley assist on haul roads (Boliden Aitik): Boliden press releases https://www.boliden.com/
- Autonomous haulage (Codelco Gaby 2008, Rio Tinto Pilbara, Komatsu FrontRunner, Cat Command): Komatsu https://www.komatsu.com/ ; Rio Tinto https://www.riotinto.com/
- BelAZ 75710 (450 t, 2013, 8 tires, two 16-cylinder engines, record 503.5 t): Wikipedia, "BelAZ 75710" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BelAZ_75710
- Haul truck blind spots, buggy whip flags, berms (mid-axle height rule): MSHA fatality reports and 30 CFR 56.9300 https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-30/part-56
- Exhaust body heating and carryback: Caterpillar / Komatsu body options literature; Wikipedia, "Haul truck"
